text: Caller reports rear-end collision on the M4 near junction 12, approx 14:30 yesterday. Third party admitted fault at the scene. Bumper and boot damage, car still drivable. Policy MI-4471-B. No injuries reported. Caller estimates 2,400 to put right.

Forwarded from broker. Insured (Ines Halvorsen) had escape of water from a first floor bathroom, discovered on the 3rd of last month, damage to ceiling below and hall flooring. Loss adjuster attended. Policy ref mi 4692 c. Two quotes attached, 8,750 and 9,100 - insured wants to use the higher one as the contractor is available sooner.
Caller says there has been some kind of incident at the property. Would not give details, said she would call back when her son is home to explain. Nothing further.

Customer slipped on the forecourt of our insured's premises on 28/07 and is claiming for a fractured wrist. Solicitor letter received quoting 12,000. Note: an earlier call logged the same claim as 1,200 - the 1,200 was a typo by the agent. Insured disputes liability, says the area was signed. No policy number given on the form, insured trades as Vulcan Autocare.

Two vehicle collision at a roundabout, our insured turning right. Insured reports neck pain and has seen a GP - possible whiplash. Other driver's vehicle recovered from scene, ours drivable. Policy MI-5013-A. Too early for a repair figure, engineer to inspect. Third party details taken but insured is unsure whether the other driver was insured.
